design_condition: The low, large volume continues the site's composition as part of the campus, while a surrounding promenade completes the pedestrian network and an entrance pocket draws visitors toward the central circulation core.

positive.statement: The volume is a logical continuation of the site composition and seems to belong to the campus family.
The entrance pocket is large and inviting, bringing visitors toward the center of the building.
The structure is efficient and allows flexible organization of the plan and future internal changes.
The premises have the right proportions and demonstrate a certain flexibility.
The strong and precise contour could express a referential lightness for the entire hospital site.

negative.statement: The circular patio voids seem too small to convincingly integrate vegetation and the surrounding landscape.
The circular patios only partially illuminate the more central premises.
The large volume puts natural luminosity in large parts of the plan center in difficulty.
The large glazed facade can become problematic for climatic issues.
The project only partially integrates sustainable-development principles.
Embodied energy consumption would be high because of low compactness, double-skin facades and a concrete roof.
